values.meaning: interval between stacks expiring once the buff duration ends
values.quote: Stacks expire one by one every {{fd|0.25}} seconds when the duration ends.
values.binNote: Wiki text states stacks fall off one every 0.25s. The bin's only candidate row, JaxPassive.FallOffRate, is 0.35, not 0.25 - same apparent quantity (seconds per stack lost on expiry), different number. Not changed to match; a dummy fight with continuous auto-attacks keeps stacks refreshed well inside either interval, so this mostly matters only if the sim models a gap in attacks (e.g. during Counter Strike's evasion).

mechanics.claim: Stacks are generated on-attack and each attack refreshes the 2.5s duration, so continuous auto-attacking keeps Jax permanently at max stacks in a dummy fight.
mechanics.quote: '''Jax's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Relentless Assault'' {{tip|on-attack}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 8 times.
